calculation_handling.description: If a lawfully existing building is deeper than the permitted maximum building depth, its lawful building depth becomes its maximum.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the as-built building depth. The clause states no date for 'lawfully existing'; the existing() date argument is keyed as enacted(569-2013) (conservative reading).

units.disclosure: A legally existing building that is already deeper than today's limit keeps its existing depth as its limit. We do not know as-built depths.

calculation_handling.description: An addition or extension to a lawfully existing building covered by 10.5.40.31(1) must comply with all other regulations of the By-law, or be authorized by a minor variance.
calculation_handling.gaps: The unit text names no zone; its scope follows 10.5.40.31(1) (Residential Zone category). The minor-variance arm is outside our evaluation.

units.disclosure: Additions to an over-deep existing building must meet all the other zoning rules unless a minor variance is granted.

10.5.40.31(1).explanation: In residential zones, a legally existing building that is already deeper than the current building depth limit may keep its existing depth as its limit.

10.5.40.31(2).explanation: An addition to such a building must meet all other zoning rules, unless a minor variance is granted.
